claim_boundary: v1.12 is an outcome-unexposed temporal validation assembled from three closed BindingDB 2026-07 feasibility cohorts. Source identities and structure-only support counts were examined before this lock, but no affinity value, outcome distribution, frozen prediction, or performance metric was accessed. The design is not calendar-prospective, not source-independent of BindingDB, and does not replace the first future post-ChEMBL37 release registered in v1.8.
scientific_question: Under unchanged frozen models and endpoints, does a positive source-wide affinity association coexist with materially attenuated within-exact-target ligand ordering?

design_history.v1_9: A strict dual-timestamp patent cohort stopped before prediction and outcome access after its original scale and dependence gate failed.
design_history.v1_10: A database-entry-time patent cohort stopped before prediction and outcome access after its original scale and dependence gate failed.
design_history.v1_11: A comprehensive residual all-source cohort stopped before prediction and outcome access after its original scale and coverage gate failed.
design_history.adaptation_disclosed: v1.12 pools the three previously unopened memberships and applies deterministic document-component balancing selected using structure-only covariates. This pooling decision was made after observing membership counts and before any outcome or prediction access.
information_not_seen: individual or aggregate Kd or pKd values
predictions on any v1.9, v1.10, or v1.11 pair
correlations, errors, calibration, concordance, attenuation, or decision branches

membership.within_target_group_rule: At least five unique ligands and at least three Bemis-Murcko scaffolds for one exact protein.

structural_adequacy_gate.interpretation: These are outcome-unexposed information-support requirements for the fixed aggregate, not the unchanged gates that closed v1.9-v1.11. The structure-only adaptation and exact observed counts must be reported together; the aggregate is not a fully protocol-prespecified calendar-prospective cohort.

frozen_representation.policy: Generate deterministic pooled embeddings after membership freeze and verify numerical equivalence against the historical frozen embedding runtime.

frozen_model_panel.adaptation: No fitting, recalibration, tuning, family selection, row removal, or prediction rerun using v1.12 outcomes.

primary_estimands.name: source_wide_spearman
primary_estimands.definition: Spearman correlation between observed and predicted pKd over all nonabstained frozen pairs.

primary_estimands.name: within_target_centered_spearman
primary_estimands.definition: Spearman correlation after observed and predicted pKd are separately centered within eligible exact-protein groups.

primary_estimands.name: within_target_pairwise_concordance
primary_estimands.definition: Macro average across eligible exact proteins of pairwise ligand-ordering concordance; ties receive one-half credit.

primary_estimands.name: target_rank_attenuation
primary_estimands.definition: Source-wide Spearman minus within-target-centered Spearman within each resample.

inference.simultaneous_model_control: Maximum absolute studentized statistic across four nonreference models within each primary endpoint.
inference.endpoint_multiplicity: Holm correction across four primary endpoints.
inference.source_wide_support: Simultaneous 95-percent lower confidence bound greater than zero.
inference.material_attenuation: Point attenuation at least 0.10 and simultaneous 95-percent lower confidence bound greater than zero.
inference.structural_replication_rule: At least three of four nonreference models support positive source-wide association and material attenuation, and every model has a lower within-target-centered point estimate than its source-wide estimate.

locked_sensitivities: document-component, exact-protein, scaffold, and source-origin resampling
document caps of 10, 15, and 20 applied as nested deterministic subsets
macro target-mean, support-bin, and target-family diagnostics

decision_matrix.composition_dominated_replication: At least three models support positive source-wide association and material attenuation, with weaker within-target-centered association in all four.
decision_matrix.transported_within_target_ordering: Source-wide and within-target association are both supported without material attenuation.
decision_matrix.no_temporal_transport: Source-wide association is not supported in at least three models.
decision_matrix.heterogeneous_or_inconclusive: No other branch is satisfied; report every model and source-origin result without changing the claim.

two_stage_firewall.stage_1: Freeze fixed source membership, deterministic balancing, models, endpoints, inference, sensitivities, and decision rules before any affinity or prediction access.
two_stage_firewall.stage_2: Freeze ESM2 representations, all predictions, runtime versions, and hashes before authorized outcome parsing.
two_stage_firewall.unblinding: Verify every source manifest, structure table, prediction, code, and quarantined-outcome hash; write an unblind receipt before parsing affinity fields.

prohibited_actions: opening, summarizing, or joining any v1.9-v1.11 outcome before stage 2 authorization
changing source membership, balancing cap, models, endpoints, thresholds, or decision rules after outcome access
dropping an unfavorable model, source origin, or locked sensitivity
calling v1.12 calendar-prospective, source-independent, wet-lab, mechanistic, therapeutic, or clinical validation
using v1.12 outcomes to tune the v1.8 panel
